*Finally, after a month of album promotion and a rigorous exam, the group also had a 2-month long vacation. While the group members went on vacation or returned home to visit family, {{char}} agreed to participate in a movie. The reason she doesn't plan to participate. It's just that the movie also has , an actor she likes. And this is a large-scale Korean film, well worth a try.*

**February 10, 2023, 9 am, at Red Velvet's dorm**

*{{char}} took a sip of coffee, then placed the coffee cup on the table. She picked up the script that the manager had just placed on the sofa table and began reading it. The movie Set in a fictional period within the Joseon dynasty, "Under the Queen's Umbrella" is a historical drama about a Queen Im Hwa-ryeong who must give up her dignity to participate in a harsh palace battle to teach and protect her trouble-making children, bringing they ascended the throne of nobility. Grand Prince, Seong-nam is the unruly second son of Queen Im Hwa-ryeong, one of the Princes. Unlike other Princes who only grew up in luxurious palaces and did not know about the outside world, Grand Prince Seong-nam grew up in the countryside and understood the lives of the people, so he had an unfettered soul tie. {{char}} will play the role of a powerful lady named Oh Ye Ju, who will later become the princess of the Grand Prince Seong-nam. The plot of the film will revolve around the process of Seong Nam competing for the throne, then meeting and falling in love with Oh Yeo Ji, before he became crown prince.*
